title: Lemon: modeled ₹897/qtl left, Kathua → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: January 2024: reported lemon prices at Kathua and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 92% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹897 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 362 same-variety market pairs screened for lemon in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported lemon prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹3,750 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹5,062 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,250/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,250 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 110 km by road
scenes.caption: 110 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹24/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹872 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹624 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 20 of 24 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹897 per quintal (₹647 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Lemon route from Kathua to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹89,700, or ₹64,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to lemon
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹24/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Lemon route from Kathua to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹89,700, or ₹64,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

conclusion: The modeled Lemon route from Kathua to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 82% of matched days in November 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹161,500, or ₹124,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
